name: accounting-exports
notes: Owns the chart of accounts, posting suggestions, the tag of each document line and the export run log; it keeps no journal, balance or statement (constitution 14, AC-3). Each export reads rows from the owning modules' query functions and is checked against a figure the same module reports through another function (BR-5); a difference aborts the run. The layout of each export is in docs/exports/<code>.md and is versioned (BR-10). A tag is one account code per document line: it takes the account the document is about (income for an invoice, the expense for a bill, the receivable for a receipt) rather than the cash side; a cash transaction and a stock movement use their direction. Tags are made at document level (line reference blank). Beyond the spec's route list the module adds GET /accounting/accounts and PUT /accounting/accounts/:code (switch an account on or off, section 3). The checksum is taken over the data section only (no header, no time). A run stores an XLSX and a CSV as attachments of entity type acc_export_run; file_id is the XLSX.
